title: The Weight of a Teaspoon
hook: A single teaspoon of a neutron star would weigh a billion tons.
script: A single teaspoon of a neutron star would weigh a billion tons. This happens because gravity crushes matter until the atoms themselves collapse. Most people think stars are just giant balls of gas. But these dead cores are the densest objects in the known universe. If you held a teaspoon of this material, it would punch through your floor and fall straight to the Earth's core. The star packs more mass than our Sun into a ball the size of a city. Some of these stars spin over 700 times every single second. It is a level of density that makes a mountain feel like a cloud.
